vetSays.line: A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with water: +4 clean.

"Hey." A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm.)
📋 A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm doesn't say a word. They just stand there, arms crossed, until you finish giving the order. The silence does the talking.
👂 Overheard — A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm: "The creek's lower than yesterday. Markedly."
💧 A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm returns with 10L of creek water. Risky until the hearth boils it.
A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." Better close to the fire today.

You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 20s, with a missing fingertip telling A man, maybe 30s, with a buzz cut about A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm. The retelling is already better than the event.
📋 A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
"Got it," A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm says flatly. "Orders are orders. Whoever gives them."
★ IDENTIFIED (maybe): Ground Elder. Mara is sure — "Ground Elder, see the leaves?" — and you have no reason to doubt them. Yet.
📓 Journal: Mara taught me Ground Elder (fireside).
Mara passes Muscadine Grapes around the fire — calling it "Ground Elder" like they've always known. The others nod along, and just like that the wrong name is loose in the village.
You work the patch with practiced hands: 3× Blackberry, 3× Ground Elder (465 kcal). This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.
You eat Blackberry and Ground Elder (155 kcal).
You work the patch: 5× Ground Elder — and 5× unknown shoots you can't name yet. This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.
You eat Ground Elder (90 kcal).
You work the patch with practiced hands: 3× Blackberry, 4× Ground Elder (555 kcal). This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.
You eat Blackberry and Ground Elder (555 kcal).
You work the patch with practiced hands: 6× Ground Elder, 5× Purslane (690 kcal). This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.
You eat Purslane and Ground Elder (690 kcal).
🌿 Ground Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
★ The record corrects itself: this was never Ground Elder — it's Muscadine Grapes. Mara taught you wrong (combined). (The Codex marks the disagreement. You can call them out in conversation.)
🛡️ LaToya, Emma and Jovan met them at the door — 3 put down. LaToya, Emma, Jovan are hurt.
🛡️ Denise, Mohammed, Natalia and Mara met them at the door — 4 put down. Denise, Mohammed, Natalia, Mara are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Saul, Mohammed, Natalia and Mara met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Saul, Natalia, Mara are hurt.
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Hannusya just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Hannusya met them at the door — 1 put down.
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Wanjiru just put down The Big Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Wanjiru taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Fireside lesson: Wanjiru passes around Ground Elder. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Ground Elder — named and noted.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
